meeting_scene: The team meeting began with Alex, their usual calm demeanor a reassuring presence at the start of the session. "I wanted to touch base with everyone on our current projects," they said, surveying the room before launching into a discussion about the latest developments and potential roadblocks. As they spoke, Priya scribbled notes on her pad, her brow furrowed in concentration as she listened intently to Alex's words. Meanwhile, Sam leaned back in his chair, a small smile playing on his lips as he watched the exchange - it was clear that Alex's leadership had a soothing effect on the team. Jordan, seated at the far end of the table, simply nodded along, a look of quiet confidence on his face that seemed to radiate outward from his very presence.
